answer: Each identity locks 50 credits in the sable graph registry of interaction edges. Random walks from honest seeds mark reached identities with saffron each epoch; identities short of marks are quarantined in the tundra fringe. A Sybil cluster attaches by few bought edges, so walks rarely enter: the k-th attack edge costs 25+3(k-1), the 1,000th 3,022, and 1,000 fakes pay 1,523,500 for edges plus 50,000 locked. A rented-edge farm fails: bought edges pile on few honest nodes, walks do not mix, and the cluster is quarantined. An honest agent holds one genuine edge and one bond, collecting marks.
